summary: Confirmed open and quoting; 2027 motorhome range widened $45-70 -> $45-120 (May low $45, July low $60); 50-amp full hookups, 135 ft; KOA's water is a fishing pond (lead); season not stated.
flags: GATE: passes at $45 on a May 2027 weeknight (back-in 30-amp, the cheapest type), but the same type is $60 on a July 2027 weeknight, so the peak cheapest is over $50. No gateway within 40 km (Cleveland 59 km, Cuyahoga Valley NP 65 km, family home 90 km). Not Good Sam (stored false, directory). Google 4.4 over 721 reviews; 10/2026 reviews on KOA's page are good ('very nice attentive staff') with 'a few dumpy seasonal campsites' and 'one of the most unleveled' sites.
LONG-STAY: KOA also sells monthly and seasonal sites ('call for availability'), but 12 RV site types quote a single night, so test 2 passes; the seasonal share isn't posted.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (downward): stored lakeview. KOA's own words are 'Stocked Fishing Pond' and 'Catch and release fishing pond'; Esri imagery at the pin shows a pond about 170 x 90 m (roughly 3 acres) in the middle of the loops, with a second smaller pond NE. No lake here: Lake Erie is '30 minutes' away. 'pond' or lower is the candidate; which pads face it wasn't plotted (no per-site map read).
Stored pin 41.69627,-81.03647 is fine: it sits in the park just south of the pond (Google's pin 41.69743,-81.03740 is ~150 m away).
SEASON: the KOA page gives no open/close dates (only the pool's 5/25-9/3); left unset. It quotes May through July 2027; the reviews above are dated 10/2026.
